Cooper Flagg climbs the HISTORY books! With 43 points tonight, Flagg brings his career total to 1,732 points, moving into third place for the most points scored by a teenager in NBA history. He passes Carmelo Anthony’s 1,725 and closes in on Kobe Bryant’s 1,759 for second place! Watch the highlights from his milestone night!
